cues.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to Matrix Printing. I’m John Smith. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Good afternoon. I’m here to reprint a brochure for our hotel. There are some pages that need revising.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Sure, how may I address you?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Oh, I’m Mary Jane from Central Hotel Chains. Nice to meet you. I’ve got samples of the previous version.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: I assume it is your company’s advertising brochure?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: What exactly is the problem?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Well, it was printed the year before, so some of the information is already out-of-date. There are also a couple of problems with the layout. Firstly, the letters of the address on the front page are far too small. It’s hard to see when glancing at the cover.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: How big do you need it to be?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Increase the letters by 3 font sizes.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Just a minute. Let me take notes of your requirements... OK, what else needs changing?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: The information regarding the pool should be deleted, because it is currently under renovation and is not available.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: So all of the relevant descriptions on page 2 should be removed? What do we replace it with? We can't just leave the whole page blank.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Just fill it in with the introduction of our newly-opened gym. I’ve included all the relevant information here in this flash drive.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Let me check...Um. I see. No problem then.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: What is also bothering us is that the description under the top photo on page 4 is incorrect. The wore lounge needs to be replaced with reception.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Fully noted. Is that all?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: No, there is more. Turn to page 5. We feel that showing merely the picture of our exterior and interior decoration does not fully represent the appeal of our hotel. On second thought, we’ve decided to use a picture with the view of the
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Do you have the original copy of the picture?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Yes, it is also enclosed in the flash drive.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: OK, we’ll reedit the whole layout of the photos.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Great.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Let’s turn to the next page.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Yes, what’s wrong with that? It seems perfectly fine to me.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: At first sight, it seems fine. But according to the feedback of the customers, the prices do not stand out, so we want to change the print from black to red to make it pop out.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: OK. I’ve made notes of all your requests. Is there anything else?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: I appreciate it. Just one final request. Could you translate the whole brochure into Spanish? We have customers worldwide, you know, especially those from Latin countries.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: No problem. What about other languages, like Japanese, Chinese or German? These are our most popular target languages.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: I have to ask the manager about the Chinese version. There’s been a surging number of Chinese clients during recent years. However, we don’t need German or Japanese translations as we currently don’t have many customers from those two countries.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: Sure. Just keep me updated.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: So roughly when could we get the revised print? We need it before the end of July.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: It’s late June now. Roughly it’ll take 3 weeks to reedit, so it will definitely be ready before the deadline.
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: Great.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: To where shall we send the samples?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: The address is No. 9 Green Drive, Cliffton, NY21300.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: How do you spell Cliffton?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: C-L-I-double F-T-O-N, Cliffton.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: And the telephone number?
cues.speaker: Employee

cues.text: It’s 9-0-3-0-3-6-6-0-2. Also, if you have any further questions, you can reach me through this number.
cues.speaker: Customer

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: Employee
